entries.note: Independent audit 2026-11-23 of all 6 keys of wire.ask_receipts in vi against en source 1ae74bc10135dee17828f58af819fc521bd1e15024b3ce466cca20e49e102507 and sidecar 48222d4c8f3d776444973f6e4b1bfc5052552dada49708c06c7faa0e53e78dfa; target 74f9a90c50d6452569c6ee1f8542d9a42be1822a85924fadca4c9a709371615b recomputed from the file after the audit edits. Method: read docs/I18N.md, glossary, the locale style guide and the sidecar; compared with the shipped relay.ask / relay.asks sibling renderings of the same states; rendered every key with local_operator.i18n.messages.render for surface remote/tui/chat/desktop/other x reason answered_in_chat/moot/absent/unknown and waited 45s/3h/42m; checked placeholder and ICU select arm parity, NFC, no manual bidi controls, no English word inside a translated sentence, and cell widths against maxCells. No catalogue edits. Findings: [minor, open/deferred] response.dismissed worst case 66/64 cells (desktop + answered_in_chat; chat + answered_in_chat 65); every other key is within its sidecar maxCells. Advisory budget (check.py does not enforce it for locales); the line wraps rather than clips. No shorter rendering keeps the shipped relay.ask/relay.asks vocabulary. Recorded here rather than in the style guide so no guide hash changes. | [nit, open/deferred] `secret question` label calques the English, which in vi is also the idiom for a password-recovery security question; the source sidecar asks for 'a question that asks for a secret'. Inherited from the English label and matched by the shipped relay.asks vocabulary, so kept; context sidecar and the card name the real meaning beside it. `terminal` and `ứng dụng desktop` stay as shipped vi vocabulary (59 / 9 uses). Evidence is this auditor's own command output in the lane session, not an external report.
